# Skimo Co

> > Specialty retailer for ski mountaineering and backcountry skiing equipment, featuring brands like Dynafit, Ski Trab, SCARPA, and Pomoca, with expert services and racing gear.

Based in Salt Lake City, Utah, Skimo Co specializes in lightweight ski touring and skimo racing equipment, offering technical expertise, binding mounting, bootfitting services, and a sister company SkyRun for mountain running. The shop serves the Wasatch Range and broader backcountry skiing community with curated gear and regional route guides.

## Key Topics

## Core Equipment Categories

- [Alpine Touring Skis](https://skimo.co/skis): Main backcountry ski catalog with race and touring models
- [Skimo Racing Skis](https://skimo.co/race-skis): Race skis including Ski Trab Gara World Cup and Dynafit DNA Pro models
- [Backcountry Ski Boots](https://skimo.co/boots): Ski touring boots featuring SCARPA Alien 5.0 and Dynafit DNA models
- [Climbing Skins for Backcountry Skis](https://skimo.co/skins): Climbing skins from Pomoca, Ski Trab, and Dynafit with mohair/nylon blends
- [Trim to Fit Skins for Skis](https://skimo.co/climbing-skins): Customizable skin kits from Pomoca, Montana, and Kohla for any ski

## Parts & Accessories

- [Tech Binding Parts & Accessories](https://skimo.co/binding-parts): Replacement parts for Dynafit, ATK, Plum, and Ski Trab tech bindings
- [Climbing Skin Parts, Cutters & Waxes](https://skimo.co/skin-parts): Skin hardware including Pomoca and Kohla race tips and attachment systems
- [Plum Guide XS Binding](https://skimo.co/plum-guide-xs): Plum Guide XS tech binding for lighter skiers with softer springs
- [Dynafit Brakes](https://skimo.co/dynafit-brakes): Replacement brakes for Dynafit bindings in multiple widths and models
- [Atomic Boot Parts](https://skimo.co/Atomic-Boot-Parts): Replacement buckles, straps, and cables for Atomic Backland boots
- [Booster Straps](https://skimo.co/booster-strap): Booster Straps power straps for improved boot flex and performance
- [Repair Tools](https://skimo.co/ski-repair-tools): P-Tex sticks, scrapers, and tools for ski base repair and maintenance

## Technical Reference

- [Technical Reference Articles](https://skimo.co/reference): Tech binding specs including heel gaps, crampon compatibility, pin heights
- [News & Articles](https://skimo.co/article/index): Ski mountaineering articles covering risk, training, and expeditions

## Guidebooks & Route Information

- [Backcountry Ski Books, Guides & Maps](https://skimo.co/books): Ski guidebooks including Training for Uphill Athlete and regional guides
- [Mark Smiley's Video Ski Guides](https://skimo.co/mark-smiley-ski-guides): IFMGA guide Mark Smiley's video tutorials for Ford-Stettner Couloir
- [Making Turns in Colorado's Front Range - Volume 2](https://skimo.co/making-turns-colorado-volume-2): Fritz Sperry guidebook with 109 routes north of I-70 in Colorado
- [Support Documents & Objective Beta](https://skimo.co/content): Chris Kussmaul Montana guides and Mark Smiley video guides library
- [Backcountry Skiing in Wyoming](https://skimo.co/wyoming): Wyoming ski objectives guide featuring Tetons and Teton Pass routes
